title: Prometheus chained in the Caucasus by Zeus

tellings.quote: Prometheus is punished by Zeus, right? And chained in the Caucasus and has his liver devoured.

plain: In the old Greek myth, Prometheus is punished by Zeus, king of the gods, by being chained in the Caucasus mountains while his liver is eaten. A researcher named Jason Jorjani retells this, naming a source rendered as Escalas, as part of a larger argument about knowledge given to humans and the price paid for it.
